questions.question: What is the primary goal of AI Safety?
options: To make AI models train faster
To make AI systems more intelligent
To ensure AI systems behave safely and beneficially

questions.question: AI Safety is mainly concerned with:
options: Ensuring AI systems remain reliable and aligned with human intentions

questions.question: The famous Paperclip Maximizer thought experiment illustrates:
options: How poorly specified objectives can create harmful outcomes

questions.question: What does AI Alignment primarily seek to achieve?
options: Ensure AI goals match human intentions

questions.question: Which statement best describes alignment?
options: Matching AI behavior with human values and goals

questions.question: Outer Alignment focuses on:
options: Whether the objective itself is correct

questions.question: Inner Alignment focuses on:
options: Whether the model internally learns the intended objective

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of specification gaming?
options: A cleaning robot hiding trash under a carpet

questions.question: Reward hacking occurs when an AI:
options: Optimizes a reward in unintended ways

questions.question: What is a major challenge in value alignment?
options: Human values are complex and sometimes contradictory

questions.question: Reliability in AI refers to:
options: Consistent and dependable performance over time

questions.question: Risk in AI can be defined as:
Which factor contributes directly to overall risk?
options: Probability of failure and impact of failure

questions.question: A highly accurate model that occasionally makes catastrophic mistakes demonstrates that:
options: Accuracy alone is not sufficient for reliability

questions.question: Distribution shift occurs when:
options: Training and real-world data differ significantly

questions.question: Human-in-the-Loop systems improve safety by:
options: Allowing humans to review important decisions

questions.question: What is the purpose of graceful degradation in AI systems?
Why is interpretability important for AI Safety?
options: It helps humans understand and verify AI decisions

questions.question: Which scenario best represents a reliability failure?
options: A medical AI performs inconsistently across patient groups

questions.question: Which sequence best represents responsible AI development?
options: Train model → Evaluate alignment and risks → Test reliability → Deploy safely
Increase model size → Skip safety checks
